summary: Preserve complete official-index discovery, shared-endpoint model merging, the embedded per-model request/input schema registry, local CLI and MCP model inspection and validation, coverage evidence, and safe disposable-mirror regeneration across future reprints.
reason: Kie publishes per-page OpenAPI fragments, including many model variants that share one endpoint. A manual page list and last-write-wins path merge lose current variants, model-specific settings, and required input metadata. The complete merger keeps every documented model contract while emitting one token-efficient shared task command. Printing Press force generation recreates its output directory, so regeneration must happen in a disposable mirror and synchronize generated artifacts back into the live worktree. Cobra-owned stdin is retained across local model validation so stdin and flag submissions receive the same preflight checks.
validated_outcome: The official Kie documentation index yielded 253 English pages, 219 OpenAPI pages/blocks, 219 documented operation variants, 70 unique API operations across 70 paths, and 129 unique Market model contracts. Every Market contract embeds its complete request and input schemas, examples, source pages, required fields, types, enums, defaults, and limits; three whitespace-corrupted upstream property names are normalized. CLI and focused MCP discovery, schema retrieval, examples, validation, the compact media-model alias, and the direct video shortcut are covered by unit and protocol tests, including Seedance 2.5's 14 documented input fields, validation for both flag and stdin task submissions, and custom direct-model inputs. A disposable-mirror reprint with CLI Printing Press 4.30.1 completed repeatedly without modifying Git metadata, preserved guided authentication and local media extensions, regenerated pristine endpoint commands, reapplied recorded stream/status compatibility patches, and passed go test ./..., go vet ./..., make build-all, targeted race tests, 15 research unit tests, generated-artifact drift checking, nine skill validators, JSON parsing, Markdown link validation, gofmt, and git diff --check. No paid/live Kie generation was submitted because no API credential was used.
